text:
sasha: Starting staggered region rollout v3.14 — US -> EU -> APAC. Soft-pin canaries, short holdpoints. Kick at :40 UTC.

deploy-bot: preflight:
• warm-pools: us=3 eu=2 apac=1
• canary slices: us=1.0%, eu=0.5%, apac=0.1%
• rollback: error>0.5% (5m) OR p95>380ms (3m) OR temp>78C

omar: US warm-pool and KV primed. Small eval set green.

deploy-bot: running ->
```
deploy --region=us --image=v3.14 --slice=1.0 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=3
```

lia: US canary healthy, p95=120ms, error=0.01%. Promoting to 10% after 10m.

deploy-bot: promoted -> 10% at +11m. Holdpoint 20m.

ops-bot: threshold monitor set (p95>320ms, temp>76C).

sasha: EU prep begins during US hold. Will warm EU caches now.

deploy-bot: starting EU canary ->
```
deploy --region=eu --image=v3.14 --slice=0.5 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=2
```

omar: EU canary live. Observability: locale tokenizer mismatch on 1 test, filing ticket but non-blocking.

deploy-bot: EU promoted to 5% at +22m; p95=165ms.

infra-bot: APAC note: ap-south capacity constrained (warm-pool=1). Recommend micro-canary and fallback route to eu.

sasha: We'll attempt APAC micro-canary 0.1% with hard thermal guard: if temp>75C or p95>350ms -> pause and flip to eu fallback (v3.13).

deploy-bot: executing APAC micro-canary ->
```
deploy --region=apac --image=v3.14 --slice=0.1 --strategy=soft-pin --warm-pool=1
```

ops-bot: ap-south-gpu-1 temp rose to 76.5C after 4m. Auto-pause triggered; routing set to eu fallback.

lia: APAC p95 jumped to 410ms before pause, retry spike noted. Good auto-pause.

sasha: Action items:
• pat -> open infra request for ap-east capacity (INF-910)
• omar -> validate eu fallback for apac traffic
• lia -> add APAC hold note in release notes and comms
• infra-bot -> confirm warm-pool expansion feasibility

deploy-bot: release note blurb:
"v3.14: inference perf and quantization improvements. Rollout: US (ramped), EU (partial), APAC (micro-canary paused; traffic routed to v3.13 EU fallback). See internal runbook for thresholds and pin steps."

pat: INF-910 created, ETA ~25m for extra ap-east nodes.

sasha: We'll reconvene at +30m to decide reattempt or defer APAC to maintenance window. Leaving this thread as canonical for tonight's region rollout decisions. :white_check_mark:
